subject.title: feat(channels): bundle Reef guarded claw-to-claw channel

question: Should OpenClaw bundle Reef's custom encrypted protocol and mutable undated guard-model exception now, or require protocol sign-off and canonical SQLite storage first?
rationale: Tests and a live-flow claim cannot decide whether the repository should own this new cryptographic trust boundary, external relay dependency, secret-state lifecycle, and acknowledged model-pinning limitation.

options.title: Gate bundling on hardening
options.body: Fix the functional defects, migrate persistent state to SQLite, add operator documentation, and obtain security review before merge.

options.title: Accept the residual risk
options.body: Merge after functional repairs while explicitly owning the custom protocol, hosted relay, and mutable undated-model limitations as bundled behavior.

options.title: Keep Reef external
options.body: Continue shipping Reef from its owner repository until protocol review and storage integration meet the bundled-plugin bar.

recommendation.title: Gate bundling on hardening
recommendation.body: Fix the functional defects, migrate persistent state to SQLite, add operator documentation, and obtain security review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the feature, documented the bundling direction and accepted residual risk, and is the strongest available product and security routing signal.
